verdict.rationale: Bench is a human-plus-software bookkeeping service, so API-driven journal-entry posting is a fair axis, but the evidence shows no public API, journal-entry posting endpoint, or review-queue workflow. Its customer-facing surface is reports, downloads and categorization assistance, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
